name: Dr. Prafull Chandra Sharma
shortBio: An experienced Ayurvedic physician dedicated to providing personalized, holistic and root-cause-focused healthcare.
description: Dr. Prafull Chandra Sharma is a dedicated Ayurvedic physician practicing from the heart of Uttarakhand, India. With a degree in Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery (BAMS), he combines classical Ayurvedic wisdom with a compassionate, patient-centered approach.

His practice focuses on understanding each patient's unique constitution (Prakriti) and designing personalized treatment protocols that address the root cause of disease rather than merely suppressing symptoms.
He specializes in Panchakarma therapies, herbal medicine, diabetes management and lifestyle modifications that help patients take a proactive approach to their long-term health and well-being.

name: Dr. Naman Singhal

description: Dr. Naman Jain is a dedicated Ayurvedic physician providing personalized and holistic healthcare.
His approach combines traditional Ayurvedic principles with a patient-centered approach to support long-term health and well-being.
He focuses on helping patients understand their health needs and adopt sustainable Ayurvedic lifestyle practices for better overall wellness.
He provides authentic Ayurvedic treatments integrated with a modern scientific approach for effective and satisfactory outcomes.

name: Dr Shivam Pant
shortBio: An experienced Ayurvedic physician with expertise in personalized holistic care, currently pursuing MD in Ayurveda.
description: Dr Shivam Pant is an experienced Ayurvedic physician with a strong focus on personalized and holistic healthcare.
He combines traditional Ayurvedic principles with modern patient-centered approaches and is currently pursuing his MD in Ayurveda to further strengthen his clinical expertise and knowledge.
His areas of expertise include Ayurvedic lifestyle management, preventive wellness, and holistic healthcare.
